title: Authorization request — an exploded view: the petition, the stations, their two-slot trays (the last stop's being the prior-examination tray), the numbered steps and the supplied state, with the links supplied between them
titleEs: Solicitud de autorización — Mecanismo o relación explicada
description: An exploded view of a petition passing to a prior-examination tray along a path configured between abstract stations: the pieces start close together — each station's plate (all the same size, on one row) with its neutral two-slot tray, the numbered steps under the trays, the placeholder petition in its column and the state piece beside the path — and are pulled apart. Only the supplied relationships are drawn, each in its kind's style (a plain relation has end dots and no arrowhead; causal only when supplied). A tracer follows the supplied traversal along the drawn links and along every numbered step to the prior-examination tray; the piece it reaches enlarges, the focus most. The state piece shows the supplied state with equal weight: ● authorization requested, or ◆ decision supplied (the decision's placeholder sheet, content never shown, in the tray's other slot). Illustrative; no criterion, threshold, time limit, rank or outcome is drawn; jurisdiction unspecified.

content.note: Visual illustration only. It does not state the law of any jurisdiction or decide validity, responsibility or outcomes.

title.description: Name of the petition sheet (fictional, as supplied)

decisions.description: The petition and the supplied decision (fictional placeholder sheets — no text is drawn on either; the decision's content is never shown)

label.description: Label of the station (fictional, as supplied)

bodies.description: Abstract stations (fictional), drawn at the same size on one row, in this order (array replaces the previous value)

steps.description: The configured path: indices in `bodies`, in the supplied order (consecutive repeats are ignored). Each step between two of them is drawn and numbered; direction comes only from this order; the last stop holds the prior-examination tray (array replaces the previous value)

routes.description: The path as configured (as supplied): abstract, fictional stations of the same size on one row, and the supplied order in which the petition passes them; the last stop holds the prior-examination tray. No rank, level or hierarchy is drawn or implied

b.description: Caption of ◆ (decision supplied, as supplied — a placeholder only)

outcomes.description: Captions of the two supplied states (equal weight; nothing is inferred from either)

route.description: Heading of the configured path (keep "as supplied")

sequence.description: Caption of the numbered steps (keep "as configured")

exam.description: Caption of the prior-examination tray (a neutral tray)

key.description: Neutral key (must say that no conclusion is drawn)

suppliedState.description: The supplied state shown on the state piece: a (● authorization requested — the petition alone) or b (◆ decision supplied — the decision's placeholder sheet, content never shown, lies in the prior-examination tray's other slot); equal weight

kind.description: relation | communication | sequence | causal (causal only when the author supplies it)

relationships.description: Explicit relationships between pieces; the kind sets the line (a plain relation has end dots and no arrowhead; causal only when supplied). A link not listed is not drawn (array replaces the previous value)

focusElement.description: Element enlarged most when the tracer reaches it

relationLabels.description: Caption of each relation kind (listed in the panel beside the line style)

traversalOrder.description: Order in which the tracer visits the pieces; it moves along a drawn link between two consecutive pieces (and along every step of the route), and starts afresh where no link joins them (array replaces the previous value)
